settings.heading: As a kids clothing brand, Kiggle has always looked to the future.

settings.text:
In a world where fast fashion often overshadows quality, we believe sustainability is essential for a better future for our children. The choices we make today impact the world our kids will inherit tomorrow. By prioritising sustainable practices and using organic cotton in our clothing, Kiggle is committed to creating clothes that are gentle on both delicate skin and the planet. 

For us, sustainability is a promise to care for the environment and nurture a responsible and conscious lifestyle for families everywhere.

settings.heading: GOTS-certified Facility
settings.text: Our clothing is made in a GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard) certified facility, ensuring we adhere to strict global standards for organic textiles. This means our garments are crafted from high-quality, natural cotton that is not only durable but also environmentally friendly.

settings.heading: Earth-Mint Technology
settings.text: Our garments feature Earth Mint technology, a plant-based antibacterial treatment that uses the natural properties of peppermint oil. This technology neutralises bacteria that come into contact with the fabric, keeping your child's clothing fresh, clean, and odour-free for longer.

settings.heading: Biodegradable Corn Packaging
settings.text: At Kiggle, we care about our planet, so we use 100% compostable mailers made from corn. This eco-friendly packaging breaks down naturally, reducing waste and helping to protect our environment for future generations.

settings.title: How do we make this happen?

settings.heading: 0% Toxic
settings.text: At Kiggle, we prioritise your child's safety by ensuring our garments are free from harmful chemicals and synthetic dyes. This approach lets your little ones enjoy vibrant, safe clothing that is kind to their skin and the planet.

settings.heading: Low Plastic Footprint / 98% Sustainable
settings.text: Our apparel contains just 2% plastic, used exclusively for the buttons. This allows us to deliver functionality and durability while staying true to our eco-friendly ethos.

settings.heading: Gender-Neutral
settings.text: Our clothing is designed to be gender-neutral, providing comfortable and stylish options for all children. This means every child can express themselves freely without the limitations of traditional gender-specific clothing.
